priorFailures.reason: Three unsupported Testing Library getByRole exact options; removed, typecheck and consolidated gates rerun.
Expanded pending list consumed fixed preview height; hidden while previewing; browser regression passed afterward.
Checkbox async state, initial focus timing and1366px action visibility corrected; test-only locator/wait/unique-code assumptions corrected. Raw red/green logs retained.

assumptions: Local digests bind content/state but do not authenticate AI origin or protect against arbitrary same-origin scripts/direct database tampering.
Blob bytes are immutable under supported APIs; current MIME/size/type metadata is revalidated.
Imported factual claims remain unverified; identity inference and automatic approval are absent.
remainingRisks: Windows Chromium only; native zoom controls and standalone screen-reader software not certified.720CSSpixels/DPR2 is the tested200percent desktop reflow equivalent.
Quota/abort regressions inject browser transaction failures; physical disk exhaustion is not certified.
Input20MiB and backup-manifest20MiB are separate bounds; an otherwise valid package can exceed resulting backup metadata capacity and is blocked.
Existing independent reference-pack associations are retained; v1 has no implicit removal/filter operation.
PR12 ZIP64 remains separate, draft, unchanged and not integration-tested with new Stage B optional fields.
Future Stage C/D transport/authentication/approval broker are not implemented.
